name: A1 Gallery

sources.title: Submit a site — 'If we like it too, we'll feature it. Current wait time for free submission is 3–4 weeks'
Pricing — Free plan includes 'Submit sites for review and track their status'; Pro ($84/yr) adds prioritised submissions + analytics

conditions: Free submissions enter a 3–4 week editorial review queue and are only featured 'if we like it too' — curation is the gate
Pro membership ($7/mo or $84/yr) gives prioritised submissions and per-site analytics but not guaranteed inclusion
requirements: This is a web-design inspiration gallery — the submitted asset is the product's WEBSITE design, not the product itself; only visually strong sites get featured
Account required: 'Log in or sign up' to submit and track status
Accepts websites and templates; entries get tagged by type, category, style, technology, and colour
preparation: A polished, distinctive marketing site or product UI — the design is what is judged
Site URL; A1 generates screenshots/taxonomy itself
Optional: submit from the account you want analytics on — 'that's how A1 knows it's yours'
workflow: Create a free account at a1.gallery/login
Open /submit and submit the site URL
Free tier: wait 3–4 weeks for editorial review; Pro tier: prioritised review
If accepted, the site appears in the gallery with filter tags; Pro unlocks impression/click analytics
watchFor: Rejection is normal — heavy curation ('if we like it too'); don't resubmit unchanged sites
Value is designer-audience referral traffic (4,350+ newsletter subscribers), not SEO — outbound links likely unfollowed
If your site is already listed by someone else, email hello@a1.gallery to link it to your account
countsAsLive: The site has a dedicated page at a1.gallery/website/<slug> browseable via gallery filters
unknowns: Whether featured sites get followed outbound links
Newsletter inclusion criteria beyond gallery acceptance
